THE CITADEL AT THE END OF TIME

FADE IN:

INT. CITADEL THRONE ROOM - NIGHT

A vast hall of green and gold. The Council: twelve thrones, all empty but one.
Candles flicker as if the air itself is holding its breath.

                    KANG (V.O.)
          You came. They always come.

THOR steps out of the shadows, gripping Stormbreaker.

                    THOR
              (through gritted teeth)
          Where are the others?
              (beat)
          Answer me!

                    KANG
          Every timeline ends, Odinson. The
          only question is who will be standing
          there when it does.

EXT. THE VOID - CONTINUOUS

Silence. A thousand timelines flicker like candles in the wind.

CUT TO:
